host: node packages/wasix-openssh/cert/run.mjs --tarball <package.tgz>: boots slicc-kernel Node entry with uplink to (1) an ephemeral host OpenSSH sshd (temp keys, loopback), (2) cert/none-auth-server.py, (3) a seeded bare git repo on the host. Runs cert/*.mjs checklist.

patches.0001-wasix-stub-getrrsetbyname.patch: SSHFP/DNSSEC getrrsetbyname always ERRSET_FAIL (no resolv.h); ordinary DNS via kernel — exercised by ssh to sshd.cert.internal / none.cert.internal
patches.0002-wasix-scp-sftp-posix-spawn.patch: scp/sftp posix_spawnp with per-call argv copy (no global args pollution; multi-source / -3)
patches.0003-wasix-quiet-unsupported-ip-tos.patc: set_sock_tos ignores ENOSYS/EOPNOTSUPP/ENOPROTOOPT so stderr stays clean
patches.0004-wasix-ssh-keygen-known-hosts-backup: ssh-keygen -R/-H backup falls back to copy when link() fails

checklist: ssh -V / ssh-keygen -t ed25519: versions and key file modes 0600 under slicc_fs
identity (10.6.0-6, wasix-sysroot -20+ credentials): the cert runs as root with root's own home /root from the kernel's passwd (until 10.6.0-5 it faked HOME=/home/user)
exec: ssh via uplink to host sshd — echo; exit 3 → 3; stdin pipe to remote cat
stderr: ssh host 'echo x >&2' → stderr exactly "x\n" (no IP_TOS spam)
publickey ed25519 against host sshd
known_hosts: StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new then mismatch refusal (isolated known_hosts file)
ssh-keygen -R hostname: updates known_hosts and keeps .old without hard links
none auth against cert/none-auth-server.py (not sshd)
PTY ssh -t via openTerminal: stty size matches cols/rows; type a command; exit; local ^C interrupts local ssh (slicc-kernel#247)
scp + sftp -b: 256 KiB up/down with sha256 checksums
scp two remote sources (sftp mode and -O) into a local dir; scp -3 remote→remote
GIT_SSH_COMMAND=ssh + wasm-git 2.55.0-15: clone and push to host bare repo over sshd
ssh-add -l without agent → exit 2 (ssh-agent not shipped; see README)

cert/users.mjs (10.6.0-6): as root and as kernel.users.add({name:'cone'}): ssh -G gives the user's name and ~ from passwd (/root, /home/cone); ssh-keygen -t ecdsa writes a 0600 key and 0644 .pub owned by that uid; ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ecdsa (~ from pw_dir, -F /dev/null) logs in to the host sshd and accept-new writes the user's own known_hosts (owned by the user); after chmod 644 the key is refused with UNPROTECTED PRIVATE KEY FILE
cert/winsize.mjs (10.6.0-6, wasix-sysroot -21 per-fd winsize): ssh -t in an 80x24 pty, remote stty size 24 80; resize to 120x40 (SIGWINCH → window-change); remote stty size 40 120
cert/marker.mjs (10.6.0-7, wasix-sysroot -28): every bin/*.wasm carries the slicc.libc custom section "wasix-sysroot 2025.9.30-N", N >= 28 (10.6.0-6: N = 22, NEGATIVE.md)

cert/ppoll.mjs (10.6.0-8, wasix-sysroot -29, homescoop#394): ssh.wasm links the libc ppoll (no homescoop_compat_ppoll; slicc.libc wasix-sysroot >= -29); ssh host 'sleep 2; echo late' prints late in about 2 s with no poll error on stderr; an idle ssh -t session (OpenSSH's client loop: signals blocked outside ppoll, pollfds with events 0 for idle channels) wakes on SIGWINCH, and the remote's WINCH trap prints the new size 50 132 within 3 s. 10.6.0-7 fails only the link check (same behaviour through the compat ppoll); -7's own build on -28 without the compat ppoll ended every session with 'poll: Function not implemented' (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/hostname.mjs (10.6.0-12, homescoop#1050; wasix-sysroot -39 by build.sh's override, >= -36's gethostname): as root and as cone, ssh-keygen -t ed25519 without -C writes the comment <user>@$HOSTNAME (the exported value, else slicc), never @wasmer.sh. 10.6.0-11 (sysroot -34): root@wasmer.sh (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/crypto.mjs (10.6.0-12, homescoop#1052): RSA-3072, ECDSA-384 and ed25519 keys with a passphrase (-y -P, a wrong passphrase refused, -p to clear it), each authorized and logged in with; ssh-keygen -Y sign/verify and a tampered message refused; Ciphers chacha20-poly1305, aes256-gcm, aes128-ctr, aes256-ctr; MACs hmac-sha2-512-etm, hmac-sha2-256, umac-128-etm; KexAlgorithms mlkem768x25519-sha256, sntrup761x25519-sha512, curve25519-sha256, ecdh-sha2-nistp256; ssh -C up and down with matching sha256 and compression in -v; ssh host yes | head ends promptly and a remote that stops reading stdin early still finishes; ssh-keygen -F finds the host

cert/heap.mjs (10.6.0-13, homescoop#1425, #1287, slicc-kernel#1172): every bin/*.wasm is a threaded bulk-memory module; built on wasix-sysroot 2025.9.30-40 (build.sh's override, whose malloc uses the initial pages) with recipe.yaml wasm.initial-memory 32MiB over a measured 14 MiB peak. 3 rounds of ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096, 50 MiB down from the host sshd (plain and -C), 50 MiB up, scp 50 MiB up and back, sftp get, and an mlkem768x25519 + aes256-gcm login, under SLICC_WASM_BACKTRACE=1: rc 0, the right sha256 and byte counts, 0 wasm traps, and each process's VmSize stays at 32,768 kB, so none calls memory.grow. 10.6.0-12 (8.75 MiB initial, no wasm: sizing) grows to 9-14 MiB (NEGATIVE.md). check-threaded-heap: PASS; off scripts/threaded-heap-allowlist.txt and scripts/reproducible-pending.json

cert/docs.mjs (10.6.0-13, homescoop#1446, #1426): the tarball's README is the committed package/README.md (no recipe-root copy; build.sh refuses one), its Built-with line and Sysroot section name the package.json homescoop.sysroot, it has a ## <version> section, it doesn't call the key comment host the exported HOSTNAME, and recipe.yaml names only that sysroot. 10.6.0-12's tarball README says -34 on a -39 build and has no -12 section (NEGATIVE.md)
